who.value: casual seller agreeing a deal in chat

job.value: send the buyer a payment request after agreeing a price

arrivedFrom.value: the chat thread with the buyer

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The seller phone is a chat with 'Deal 👍' agreed, but nothing on screen says a payment request is the next step.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The payment-request entry is a small wallet icon beside 'Type here...', while a teal 'Leave review' button is the strongest control in the header.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Leave review' and 'Archive chat' are clear, but the unlabelled wallet icon next to the input doesn't say it creates a payment request.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Chat copy and 'Listed S$68.00' use everyday words.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Nothing is asked of the seller yet beyond choosing to act in the chat.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The chat shows only the item strip, two header buttons and messages.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: A primary 'Leave review' button shows before any sale has happened, which belongs to after the transaction.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The screen is chat bubbles and short buttons, with no explanatory paragraph.
